unknown.hint: Look at the agent's log on the host and at the Coaming logs.

agent_offline.hint: Check that it's running. It reconnects by itself when it can reach Coaming.

tls_untrusted.text: The agent doesn't trust Coaming's certificate.
tls_untrusted.hint: Use a certificate from a public CA, or reinstall the agent with the command from Show install command. It carries the certificate pin.

auth_rejected.hint: Generate a new join token and reinstall the agent with the new command.

cert_expired.text: The agent's certificate expired before it could renew.
cert_expired.hint: Reinstall the agent with a fresh join token. It enrols again with a new certificate.

unknown_agent.text: {{node}} was installed after the last backup.
unknown_agent.textGeneric: An agent was installed after the last backup.
unknown_agent.hint: Reinstall the agent with the command from Show install command.

cert_expiring.text: The agent's certificate on {{node}} is about to expire.
cert_expiring.textGeneric: An agent certificate is about to expire.
cert_expiring.hint: The agent renews it by itself while it is connected. If this stays, reinstall the agent with a fresh join token.

revoked.hint: Remove the agent from the host. To let it back in, unblock the node in Settings. Its agent enrols again by itself if it still has its join token.

blocked.textGeneric: A node is blocked from enrolling.
blocked.hint: Unblock it in Settings → Environments, in the nodes list.

version_incompatible.text: Agent {{version}} can't talk to this Coaming.
version_incompatible.textGeneric: The agent can't talk to this Coaming.
version_incompatible.older: The agent is older than Coaming supports.
version_incompatible.newer: The agent is newer than this Coaming.

clock_skew.text: The clock on {{node}} is {{offset}} out of step.
clock_skew.textGeneric: The clock on a node is out of step.
clock_skew.hint: Sync the host's clock (NTP). Coaming accepts up to 5 minutes of difference.

timeout.hint: Check the network between the host and Coaming. The agent reconnects by itself.

not_a_manager.hint: Only worker nodes are connected. Check the agent on a manager node, and that the manager is running.

no_quorum.hint: Bring a manager node back online. Coaming can't read cluster data until most managers are up. Node-local data still works.

cluster_changed.hint: Adopt the new cluster to keep this environment, or remove it.

engine_unreachable.text: The agent can't reach Docker on {{node}}.
engine_unreachable.hint: Check that `/var/run/docker.sock` is mounted into the agent and that the Docker daemon is running.

unsupported_engine.textGeneric: Docker on a node isn't supported.
unsupported_engine.hint: Coaming needs Docker Engine 24 or later. Upgrade Docker on that node. Its other data is left out until then.

agent_policy_denied.hint: The host's agent policy doesn't allow it. This is recorded in the audit log. If you didn't expect it, check the Coaming server and the agent's settings.

duplicate_environment.textGeneric: This host already belongs to another environment.
duplicate_environment.hint: Open {{environment}}, or remove it first, then enrol this host again.
duplicate_environment.hintGeneric: Open the other environment, or remove it first, then enrol this host again.

type_mismatch.textGeneric: This host is a different type from the environment it tried to join.
type_mismatch.hint: Add it as a separate environment.

host_mismatch.textGeneric: This environment already manages a different host.
host_mismatch.hintGeneric: Add this host as its own environment.

unreachable.text: Docker isn't answering on the local socket.
unreachable.hint: Check that `/var/run/docker.sock` is mounted into Coaming and that the Docker daemon is running.

api_too_old.text: This Docker Engine is older than Coaming supports.
api_too_old.hint: Coaming needs Docker Engine 24 or later. Upgrade Docker Engine, then retry.

rootless.hint: Coaming manages Docker Engine 24 or later.

docker_desktop.hint: Coaming manages Docker Engine 24 or later.

address_space_full.textGeneric: An address pool or network is almost full.
address_space_full.hint: Remove orphaned networks or use smaller subnets before new stacks fail to deploy.
